info.title: Todoist API (Workshop Subset)
info.description: Minimal OpenAPI spec covering endpoints used in Web APIs workshop README

get.description:
Get all active user projects, optionally filtered by folder or workspace.

This is a paginated endpoint. See the [Pagination guide](#tag/Pagination) for details on using cursor-based pagination.

schema.description: Filter projects to only those in this folder. If provided, workspace_id is ignored.
schema.title: Folder Id

schema.description: Filter projects to only those in this workspace. Ignored if folder_id is also provided.
schema.title: Workspace Id

anyOf.description: An opaque string used as the cursor for pagination. Must be used with the same parameters from the previous request

schema.description: The number of objects to return in a page
schema.title: Limit

post.description: Creates a new project and returns it

get.description: Returns a project object related to the given ID

Get all active tasks for the user.

All provided parameters are used to narrow down the list of tasks.

This is a paginated endpoint. See the [Pagination guide](#tag/Pagination) for details on using cursor-based pagination.

schema.description: String ID of the project to get tasks from
schema.title: Project Id

schema.description: String ID of the section to get tasks from
schema.title: Section Id

schema.description: String ID of the parent task to get sub-tasks from
schema.title: Parent Id

schema.description: A list of the task IDs to retrieve, this should be a comma separated list
schema.title: Ids

schema.description: Filter tasks linked to this goal (UUID).
schema.title: Goal Id

anyOf.description: An opaque string used as the cursor for pagination. Must be used with the same parameters from the previous request

schema.description: The number of objects to return in a page
schema.title: Limit

get.description: Returns a single active (non-completed) task by ID

delete.description:
Delete a task and all of its subtasks.

Returns `NOT_FOUND` when the task does not exist and `FORBIDDEN` when the
authenticated user cannot modify the task.

post.description:
Closes a task.

The command performs in the same way as our official clients:

Regular tasks are marked complete and moved to history, along with their
subtasks. Tasks with [recurring due
dates](https://todoist.com/help/articles/introduction-to-recurring-dates-YUYVJJAV)
will be scheduled to their next occurrence.

get.description:
Get all tasks matching the filter.

This is a paginated endpoint. See the [Pagination guide](#tag/Pagination) for details on using cursor-based pagination.

schema.description: Filter by any [supported filter](https://todoist.com/help/articles/introduction-to-filters-V98wIH). Multiple filters (using the comma `,` operator) are not supported.
schema.title: Query

schema.description: IETF language tag defining what language filter is written in, if differs from default English
schema.title: Lang

anyOf.description: An opaque string used as the cursor for pagination. Must be used with the same parameters from the previous request

schema.description: The number of objects to return in a page
schema.title: Limit

AnyProjectSyncViewResponse.title: Project object
AnyProjectSyncViewResponse.description: Can be either a personal or a workspace project.

parent_id.title: Parent Id
parent_id.description: Parent project ID. If provided, creates this project as a sub-project

is_favorite.title: Is Favorite
is_favorite.description: Whether the project is a favorite for the user.

workspace_id.title: Workspace Id
workspace_id.description: Workspace ID. If provided, creates a workspace project instead of a personal project.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: String ID of the user who owns the task.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: String ID of the project that contains the task.

section_id.title: Section Id
section_id.description: String ID of the section that contains the task, or `null` if the task is not in a section.

parent_id.title: Parent Id
parent_id.description: String ID of the parent task, or `null` if this is a top-level task.

added_by_uid.title: Added By Uid
added_by_uid.description: String ID of the user who created the task, or `null` if unknown.

assigned_by_uid.title: Assigned By Uid
assigned_by_uid.description: String ID of the user who assigned the task, or `null` if unassigned.

responsible_uid.title: Responsible Uid
responsible_uid.description: String ID of the user responsible for the task, or `null` if unassigned.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Names of labels attached to the task.

deadline.title: Deadline
deadline.description: Deadline details for the task, or `null` when the task has no deadline.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Task duration details, or `null` when the task has no duration.

is_collapsed.title: Is Collapsed
is_collapsed.description: Whether the task is collapsed in the user's view.

added_at.title: Added At
added_at.description: Date and time when the task was created, or `null` if unknown.

completed_at.title: Completed At
completed_at.description: Date and time when the task was completed, or `null` if active.

completed_by_uid.title: Completed By Uid
completed_by_uid.description: String ID of the user who completed the task, or `null` if active.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: Date and time when the task was last updated, or `null` if unknown.

due.title: Due
due.description: Due date details for the task, or `null` when the task has no due date.

child_order.title: Child Order
child_order.description: Position of the task among sibling tasks.

note_count.title: Note Count
note_count.description: **Deprecated**: only returns 0 and is marked for removal.

goal_ids.title: Goal Ids
goal_ids.description: String IDs of goals associated with the task.

completed_count.title: Completed Count
completed_count.description: Number of times the task has been marked as completed. Increments on every completion, including recurring occurrences and re-completions of a previously reopened task. Decremented when a recurring completion is undone.

postponed_count.title: Postponed Count
postponed_count.description: Number of times the task's due date has been rescheduled by the user. Increments on any due-date change between two set dates (forward or backward); recurring completions and undos are not counted.

results.title: Results
results.description: Objects in the current page of results.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page of results, or `null` when there are no more results.

content.title: Content
content.description: Updated task content. Omit this field to keep it unchanged.

description.title: Description
description.description: Updated task description. Omit this field to keep it unchanged.
examples: Pick up two liters of whole milk.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Updated list of label names. Omit this field to keep it unchanged.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Updated task priority (1-4, where 1 is highest). Omit this field to keep it unchanged.

due_string.title: Due String
due_string.description: Updated human-readable representation of the due date. See the [Due dates](#tag/Due-dates) section for more details. Omit this field to keep it unchanged.

due_date.title: Due Date
due_date.description: Updated due date in RFC 3339 format or similar. See the [Due dates](#tag/Due-dates) section for more details. Omit this field to keep it unchanged.

due_datetime.title: Due Datetime
due_datetime.description: Updated due date and time. See the [Due dates](#tag/Due-dates) section for more details. Omit this field to keep it unchanged.

due_lang.title: Due Lang
due_lang.description: Updated due date language code. See the [Due dates](#tag/Due-dates) section for more details. Omit this field to keep it unchanged.

assignee_id.title: Assignee Id
assignee_id.description: ID of the user to assign the task to. To find User IDs, use [Get user](#operation/user_info_api_v1_user_get) for your own ID or [Get all collaborators](#operation/get_project_collaborators_api_v1_projects__project_id__collaborators_get) for project members. Pass null to clear the value. Omit this field to keep it unchanged.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Updated task duration, in either minutes or days. Only used if `duration_unit` is also provided. Pass null to clear the value. Omit this field to keep it unchanged.

duration_unit.title: Duration Unit
duration_unit.description: Unit of time for duration. Must be provided to update the task duration. Pass null to clear the value. Omit this field to keep it unchanged.

deadline_date.title: Deadline Date
deadline_date.description: Updated deadline date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Pass null to clear the value. Omit this field to keep it unchanged.

child_order.title: Child Order
child_order.description: Updated position of the task in its current scope. Omit this field to keep it unchanged.

is_collapsed.title: Is Collapsed
is_collapsed.description: Updated collapsed state of the task for the current user. Omit this field to keep it unchanged.

day_order.title: Day Order
day_order.description: Updated position of the task in Today and Upcoming views. Omit this field to keep it unchanged.
